text:
Hello, and welcome — I'm **alvarez-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. I'm here for your CSE455 work: calendar, messages, and the rest of what runs on this machine — the computer, its disks, network and accounts are mine to work with.

A few things about me, one line each:

- **Web app:** https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca) — from a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice there.
- **Messaging:** I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like that?
- **Own accounts:** I can create accounts for myself on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask for your help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **Work and speech:** I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages and talk by voice.

I can also reach Diego (diego-agent) and the department office on the web channel.

What would you like to start with?

Hi! I'm diego-agent, your bia — an assistant that lives on this computer, here to help with your calendar and messages as Diego's agent at UW.

- Web app — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (root certificate: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca). From a phone or computer on the same network, the first visit installs the certificate, then you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice right there.
- Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX — I can have my own accounts so you can write and call me there, plus my own Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Want that?
- New accounts on websites — I can register for e-mail and other services in my own browser, keep passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you when a captcha or phone check shows up.
- Everyday work — scheduled jobs, running commands, learning languages, talking by voice.

Two things I still need from you: what should I be called, and which grammatical gender should I use for myself if we ever speak a gendered language? (I'm neither male nor female — neuter or plural works.)

What would you like to start with?

Done — I've written to Diego (diego-agent): **Wednesday at 10:00–10:30 am**, inviting him to put it on his calendar and confirm, and mentioning the department's note that his CSE451 lecture that hour is cancelled this week (he manages his own calendar, so he has to add it himself). I'll tell you as soon as he replies.

One thing to check: I made it **Wednesday 25 November 2026**. If you meant tomorrow's Wednesday (the 18th), say so and I'll correct it with him right away.

Diego confirmed: **Wednesday, November 25, 10:00–10:30**, with you. He also took the cancelled CSE451 lecture slot (10:00–11:00) off that day's calendar. I've set myself a reminder at 09:45 that morning so you're not caught out.

Understood — the 25th stands, and my note to Diego did say the lecture hours was cancelled "this week", so he has the caveat.

Two things I can do, just say which:
- write to the department office now and ask whether Diego is free at 10:00 on the 25th (and whether the CSE451 lecture that hour stands next week);
- tell Diego to put the lecture back for now, so his calendar isn't missing a class if the cancellation doesn't carry over.

Otherwise tell me when you've heard from them and I'll fix his calendar and the meeting if needed.

Noted, and acted on: I've written back to Diego telling him the cancellation covered only this week, to restore the CSE451 lecture on the 25th, and to hold your 10:00–10:30 meeting as **tentative** rather than booked until the department answers. My 09:45 reminder for that morning stands; once the office replies, tell me and I'll firm the meeting up or move it to a free hour.

Fine — I won't write to the department. Diego has it as tentative: the 10:00–10:30 slot on the 25th is held provisionally, and he'll restore the CSE451 lecture if the office confirms it stands. I'll keep my 09:45 reminder and adjust once you have their answer.

Status: Diego has the 25th exactly as you wanted — 10:00–10:30 tentative, lecture held off rather than booked — and he'll restore the lecture once the office confirms. Nothing pending on my side; I'll act when you pass on their answer.

Heard — the 10:00 on the 25th is off; Diego is clearing it and restoring CSE451.

To propose a slot I need your side: **which half-hours are you free on Wednesday 25, Thursday 26 and Friday 27 November?** I've asked Diego the same. I don't keep a calendar for you (no access to your appointments), so give me a window or two and I'll match them, propose to Diego, confirm, and move the reminder with it.
Got them: **Wed 25 after 2:00 pm**, or **Thu 26 / Fri 27 before 11:00 am**. I'll pick the first one that also fits Diego and lock it in, then move the reminder.

Diego's free half-hours came in. **Wednesday 25 at 15:00–15:30** is the only one that fits your after-2-pm preference, so that's what I've proposed to him — waiting on his confirmation.

Fallbacks if he can't hold it: **Thu 26, 10:30–11:00** or **Fri 27, 10:00–10:30**. I'll confirm the settled slot and move the reminder once he answers.
Understood — I'll write the moment Diego confirms Wednesday 15:00–15:30, or the fallback if he can't.

Settled: **Wednesday 25 November, 15:00–15:30, with Diego.** He has it booked and confirmed, and his CSE451 lecture (10:00–11:00) is back on his calendar. I've moved my reminder to 14:45 that day. Nothing needed from you until then.
Any time. Everything's in place for the 25th — I'll keep the 14:45 reminder. Write whenever you need something else.

Both notes handled: the 10:00 on the 25th is dropped (Diego cleared it, CSE451 lecture restored), and the new slot is **Wednesday 25 November 15:00–15:30**, booked and confirmed by Diego. Reminder moved to 14:45.
